issue_context.title: [Feature] introduce predicate web-first assertions
issue_context.body:
Context: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/10187

In general, this is a feature request to support predicate as an argument to `expect`:

```js
await expect(asyncPredicate).toBe(10);
```

The `await expect(..)` construct should retry predicate until it reaches certain value.
comments:
> ```js
> expect(page.locator('[e2e-target="summary-cost"]').getAttribute('e2e-data').then((value: string): number => Number(value))).greaterThan(1000);
> ```

This won't work since this passes in a promise, whereas we need a promise factory to be able to retry. Thus we'd need to have async function.

Following your example, it'd look like this:

```js
await expect(() => page.locator('[e2e-target="summary-cost"]').getAttribute('e2e-data')).toBeGreaterThan(5, { timeout: 3000 });
```
This looks great as a "`waitForFunction`" that runs in Playwright's context!

review_comments: do you support the `not` property? `expect(() => atSomePointImTrue()).not.toBeTruthy()`
Then I'd do `ExpectMetaInfo = CommonExpectOptions & { isSoft, isPoll, isNot }` and pass it around everywhere.
lets add a test for that?
there's a test for custom matchers!
